subject: Follow-up: Sherwood HealthTech model-fit, eval links & throughput tradeoffs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sherwoodhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + initial model suggestions (Sherwood POC)

Hi Marta — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) What we heard
- Primary goal: near real-time clinical note summarization and error-detection pipeline for internal QA (90–150 token outputs).
- Constraints: PII in transit, strict retention policy, latency target 150–250ms p95 for single-user flows, bursty traffic during end-of-day processing.
- Success metrics: ROUGE-style summary fidelity on our eval set (target >= 0.84), and no significant downstream QA regression after quantization trials.

2) Recommended POC scope
- 2-week focused POC: model-fit + latency/throughput sweep with your sample prompt sets -> compare AWQ, GPTQ-8, and FP8 variants.
- Deliverables: benchmark CSV, annotated prompt set, recommended rollout config (canary + fallback), and regression checklist.

3) Initial model recommendations (based on call and sample sizes)
- Candidate A (better baseline quality, heavier): rw-llama-70b (AWQ 4-bit) — expect highest quality, modest throughput hit.
- Candidate B (balanced): rw-mistral-33b (GPTQ-8) — good latency, smaller quality delta on summarization tasks.
- Candidate C (latency-optimized): rw-pegasus-13b (FP8) — best throughput/latency, potential small drop on edge-case hallucinations.

4) Risks we’ll watch for
- Quantization regressions on long-tail prompts (legal disclaimers, multi-paragraph notes).
- Tokenization edge-cases causing summary truncation.

5) Next steps
- We’ll provision a reserved POC pool and run an initial sweep against your prompt_set_v1 (please upload latest version to the Drive link below).
- Proposed kickoff: Wednesday 24 Jun, 10am PT — 30 mins to align measurement and SLAs.

Attachments: prompt_set_v1.txt (please confirm this is the latest), initial_benchmark_template.csv (blank).

Link to shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sherwood-eval-results

Thanks — I’ll follow up after you confirm the kickoff slot.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + initial model suggestions (Sherwood POC)

Quick internal note on the quant/throughput plan before we present to Sherwood: 

- Measurement matrix (we’ll produce):
  * Datasets: sherwood_sample_20 + 2 stratified slices (long clinical notes, short encounter notes).
  * Metrics: ROUGE-L, BLEU, summary-length-preservation, hallucination rate (binary), latency p50/p95, tokens/sec.
  * Variants: rw-llama-70b {AWQ-4}, rw-mistral-33b {GPTQ-8}, rw-pegasus-13b {FP8}, and a small fp16 baseline (pegasus-13b-fp16) for signal.

- Expected performance tradeoffs (estimate):
  * AWQ-4 (llama-70b): quality delta vs fp16 ~ -0.02 ROUGE-L on average; latency +20–40% single-stream.
  * GPTQ-8 (mistral-33b): quality delta ~ -0.01; latency +10–20%.
  * FP8 (pegasus-13b): quality delta variable (-0.03 to +0.00 depending on prompt class); latency -30–50% vs fp16.

- Safeguards for hallucinations (customer-facing):
  * n-gram overlap checks and factuality heuristics during POC; automatic fallback to fp16 for flagged prompts in canary route.
  * Prompt engineering: strong instruction preamble + QA checks in evaluation harness.
  * Post-generation reranking using a lightweight verifier model (small 2–4B) if latency budget allows.

- Compliance note: for POC we can run the most sensitive dataset runs on a Private deployment node (VPC) — need security approval. Karthik, please confirm whether Sherwood requires this for the kickoff.

I’ve attached a blank bench CSV (sherwood_bench_template.csv) in the Drive link. I’ll produce estimated run-times by EOD tomorrow.

—
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Next steps + kickoff invite (Sherwood POC)

Hi Marta — thanks for the prompt reply and for sharing the sample set. Confirming kickoff: Thu 24 Jun, 10am PT (calendar invite sent). Below is the consolidated plan and immediate asks so the POC is effective: 

Plan (two-week focused POC) - Week 0 (alignment + data prep): validate prompt_set_v1, confirm sensitive-sample subset for Private runs. - Week 1 (model sweep): run fp16 baseline + AWQ-4 (rw-llama-70b), GPTQ-8 (rw-mistral-33b), FP8 (rw-pegasus-13b). - Week 2 (analysis + canary config): present bench results, recommended canary with auto-fallback rules, and rollout checklist.

What we’ll report
- CSV with per-prompt metrics (ROUGE-L, hallucination flag, latency p50/p95).
- A short doc with recommended deployment profile (batching, KV cache TTL, per-route SLOs).
- Suggested quantization strategy: start with GPTQ-8 on mistral-33b for canary; if quality meets threshold, expand AWQ-4 trials against the long-note slice.

Compliance & private data runs
- We can exclude PHI from hosted logs by toggling retention + redaction. For the sensitive-sample subset, we recommend running on a Private node (VPC) to be safe — please confirm whether Sherwood requires that.

Immediate asks from you (before EOD Fri)
- Confirm prompt_set_v1 is final (or upload updated file to the Drive link).
- Flag any required Private-run samples.
- Confirm whether a DocuSign for the POC SOW is needed (we can send a short SOW + standard SLA).

Attachments referenced: sherwood_poc_results.csv (will be filled after Week 1), prompt_set_v1.txt (received), sla_terms_draft.pdf (SOW/SLA stub).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sherwood-eval-results
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SHT-2026-042

If that all looks good I’ll loop in Engineering to provision the reserved pool and send the invite with the dashboard link.

Best,
